title: Officer Studio screen view model
description: What every Officer Studio, Verify, Portal and Admin screen in the mockup reads. It is a UI binding contract, not a domain schema: each definition is a projection of the existing contracts named in x-source (packages/contracts/src/spatial/core and packages/contracts/src/usp). It carries no sample data. Any source format reaches these screens through an intake profile and a field mapping; unmapped source fields are kept as attributes, never dropped.

counts.description: At most three scope-qualified counts for Batches (H99 Z3). Each links to the list behind it.

id.description: Literal id; leading zeros and case preserved

Text.description: Display text taken from a source or a record. Never generated to fill a gap.

Unit.description: Unit as stated by the source or produced by a recorded conversion. Open list: new units arrive with new profiles.

Derivation.description: How a value came to exist. For geometry, the H22 Z1 fields on GeometryRef govern the map encoding: measured, documented and declared values sit on evidence_linked geometry; estimated maps to estimated; illustrative to illustrative.

Value.description: Every displayed fact. The five states stay distinct; unknown, withheld, not_applicable and conflicting never render as 0, blank or success.

requiredRole.description: For withheld: the role that may see it (renders as Restricted)

Rational.description: Exact share arithmetic (RIGHTS-01: no floating point). The UI formats percent from numerator/denominator.

SourceField.description: Where a mapped value came from in its original file, whatever the format.

name.description: Literal column, attribute, key, tag or label as written in the source

path.description: Column index, JSON pointer, XPath, layer/attribute, IFC property path, band name

Attribute.description: A source field that has no mapped concept yet. Shown under Source attributes in the inspector; never discarded.

Locator.description: Opens the exact place in the source. The evidence viewer picks its preview from kind, not from file extension.

label.description: Human form of the locator, for example a page, row range or element id

ProvenanceFlags.description: Only data sets these. The UI never adds a disclaimer badge by itself.

testFixture.description: Renders the Test fixture badge on the object and in the legend

seededCase.description: Renders the Seeded test case badge

replayedAt.description: Model answer replayed from an offline rehearsal profile

Status.description: Fixed status words from the design system README. No synonyms.

classification.description: Shown as-is in the scope strip. Comes from the dataset record, never hard-coded.

ActionableError.description: Says what happened and what to do; originals are kept.

crs.description: As stated or chosen; shown in the readout

label.description: Named once at the top of the level rail, for example 'm · <reference>'

target.description: Route or list the count opens

Readiness.description: Per named task; no single score. Unknown dimensions are hatched.

IdentifierAssertion.description: The state's parcel code. Absent is a valid state; it is never fabricated.

GeometryRef.description: Opaque handle to renderable geometry held by the shared map runtime (H99). The view model never embeds meshes. Fill and outline encodings follow geometryClass and record state (map-and-3d.md); measurement and checks accept only analyticEligible geometry that is not a context mesh.

semanticLod.description: CityGML LoD label; never call a tile refinement level 'LoD'

levelsKnown.description: False shows the building as massing only with 'height unknown'

saved.description: During import: present on the map once its chunk is saved

levelSummary.description: Short form built from levels, never typed by hand

Level.description: Levels come from data in their own order and labels. Nothing assumes a ground-plus-N pattern.

kind.description: H22 Z3 levelKind. Level order and naming come from the source; an unrecognised kind keeps its source label with kind unknown.
Open list from the source or mapping

rights.description: Drives Colour by Rights. Unknown is hatched.

facts.description: Further labelled facts in inspector order (parking, use, occupancy and so on). Labels come from the mapping registry.

ProjectCode.description: 3D ULPIN (proposed). Opaque; no segment tooltips on it.

value.description: Present only when assigned, retired or cancelled

LocationLine.description: Display-only location, separate from the code. Segments carry their own explanations.

definition.description: Carpet, built-up, super built-up: differing definitions render Not comparable

Selection.description: Survives 2D/3D, Model/Volumes, theme and panel changes.

Finding.description: Ordered blocking, then severity, then size. Arithmetic lines are computed by the check, never by the UI.

Action.description: Fixed labels from the design system; the view model says whether each is allowed and why not.

depthRange.description: Ruler extent derived from the deepest known band

kind.description: Utility type, corridor, basement or 'no_survey'. Utility types map to --ui-utility-* colours

positionalTolerance.description: A sleeve is drawn only when this is known

actor.description: Display name or role from the principal record

label.description: Exact next action built from the blocking item

IntakeSession.description: Add files and the live import tray. Any file is accepted: a profile is detected or marked unknown, a mapping is proposed, reused or done by hand, and every unmapped field stays as an attribute.

saved.description: Running count of saved objects for the scope strip

name.description: Original file name, shown in mono

profile.description: Detected source profile. New profiles register in the ingestion profile registry; the screen needs no change.

unit.description: What was counted: features, rows, pages, points, elements, tiles, layers

concept.description: Target concept id from the conversion registry (H14 Z2)

MappingQuestion.description: Only uncertain mappings ask. Text is generated from the field and the candidate concept, not stored copy.

Candidate.description: AI building or room candidate: a suggestion until an officer accepts it.

SufficiencyDecision.description: Per object and task. Never fills coordinates, CRS, vertical reference, analytic level elevations, unit boundaries, rights, identifiers, utility depths or control points.

unlocks.description: What answering or supplying the missing item would enable

text.description: Shown on the map while the layer is visible

stale.description: Shows the 'Updating' marker while a derivative regenerates

ContextObject.description: A generated or context-layer object in the Enhanced view. Never a property; selection shows 'Context building · no record'.

rule.description: The deterministic rule that shaped it, for example the height tier used
